home_tagline: A personal web platform — developer tools, games, CV, and more. Built with Rust, Leptos, and WebAssembly.
home_tools_desc: Developer utilities — Markdown Studio, JSON, JWT, and more.
tools_markdown_desc: Live Markdown editor with Mermaid diagram support.
tools_json_desc: Validate, format, and minify JSON in your browser.
tools_jwt_desc: Decode JWT header, payload, and signature locally.
tools_base64_desc: Encode and decode UTF-8 text as standard Base64 locally.
tools_time_desc: World clock, countdown, stopwatch, ruler, and timestamp utilities.
tools_market_desc: View the latest market-stock data returned by CafeF.
tools_no_results: No tools found. Try another search term.
footer_client: 100% client-side · No data leaves your browser
games_subtitle: Small games running entirely in your browser.
tools_desc_xml: Format XML locally in your browser.
tools_desc_html: Format HTML markup with readable indentation.
tools_desc_javascript: Format JavaScript source with basic indentation.
tools_desc_regex: Test, inspect, and replace regular-expression matches.
tools_desc_url: Encode and decode URL components locally.
tools_desc_timestamp: Convert Unix timestamps and ISO dates.
tools_desc_color: Convert HEX, RGB, and HSL color values.
tools_desc_cron: Validate and explain five-field cron expressions.
tools_desc_http_status: Look up common HTTP status codes.
tools_desc_subnet: Calculate IPv4 network and host ranges.
tools_desc_qr: Generate an SVG QR code locally.
tools_desc_json_path: Evaluate simple JSONPath expressions against JSON.
tools_desc_json_to_type: Generate Rust, C#, TypeScript, Go, or Python types from JSON.
tools_desc_curl: Build cURL commands from a compact request definition.
tools_desc_http_headers: Parse and explain raw HTTP headers.
tools_desc_openapi: Inspect OpenAPI JSON or YAML documents locally.
tools_desc_sql_to_entity: Generate backend entities from simple SQL CREATE TABLE statements.
tools_desc_git: Generate safe Git commands without executing them.
tools_desc_gitignore: Generate a combined .gitignore for common stacks.
tools_desc_chmod: Convert Unix permission bits between numeric and symbolic forms.
tools_desc_mime: Look up MIME types by extension or media type.
tools_desc_diff: Compare two text documents and show changed lines.
tools_desc_fake_data: Generate deterministic local test data without network calls.
tools_desc_mock_json: Generate repeated JSON records from an example object.
tools_desc_number_base: Convert integers between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal.
tools_desc_html_entity: Encode or decode common HTML entities.
tools_desc_unicode_escape: Escape or unescape Unicode code points.
tools_proxy_desc: Call JSON APIs through the proxy and minimize responses for compact output.
market_source: Market data supplied directly by CafeF.
